verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a retrievable, timestamped audit trail of human and automated case decisions. What it does show is adjacent: a webhook that fires when a manual review occurs, evaluation results returned in API responses, and a vague marketing claim of 'fully auditable agentic automation'. None of these describes an audit log a compliance officer can retrieve with timestamps covering both human and automated decisions.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can retrieve a timestamped audit trail of human and automated case decisions
